cards.title: Figma Announces New Agent Features
cards.body: Figma is releasing new features to define how AI agents work on its platform. Code layers feature is now available in open beta.

cards.title: Recursive Intelligence Designs AI Chips
cards.body: Recursive Intelligence is developing AI that can design chips and learn from each iteration. The startup aims to automate and accelerate the entire chip design process.

cards.title: Gudea Prevents Social Media Crises
cards.body: Gudea uses AI to help organizations prevent social media crises before they escalate. The platform tracks how stories spread across social media and websites worldwide.

cards.title: Flock Gunshot Detection Under Scrutiny
cards.body: Flock faces mounting privacy concerns from the ACLU and public advocates. CEO's claims about microshot detection capabilities conflict with the company's website descriptions.

cards.title: YouTube Music Labels AI-Generated Tracks
cards.body: YouTube Music is launching new labels to identify AI-generated music as it floods streaming platforms. Labels will appear on player pages for fully or partially AI-generated songs.

cards.title: Apate Deploys AI Agents as Fraud Bait
cards.body: Apate.ai sends AI agents undercover to get scammed and gather fraud intelligence. The approach differs from typical AI uses like product shipping or workflow automation.

cards.title: Deezer Filters Out AI-Generated Music
cards.body: Deezer is rolling out a new toggle to let users filter out AI-generated music. The feature will be available by the end of 2026.

cards.title: Zenzap Raises $44M for Workplace Chat
cards.body: Zenzap raised $44M for its AI chat app designed to replace WhatsApp in enterprise settings. The platform is already used by Starbucks and Taco Bell.

cards.title: Floqer's AI Agents Research Sales Prospects
cards.body: Floqer uses AI agents to research sales prospects so teams don't have to manually research. The platform addresses a persistent pain point in sales and revenue operations.

cards.title: Scimplify Raises $25M for Critical Materials
cards.body: Scimplify raised $25M to challenge China's dominance in critical materials using AI. The company's annualized revenue run rate tripled to $200M as it expands in the U.S.

cards.title: Science Corporation Implants Vision-Restoring Chip
cards.body: Science Corporation implanted its vision-restoring chip in its first Stargardt disease patient. Max Hodak, former Neuralink co-founder, discussed the work with PRIMA as a step toward novel brain-computer interfaces.

cards.title: Cerebras CEO Predicts Personal AI Assistants
cards.body: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman predicts personal AI assistants will become as commonplace as household appliances. These assistants will run partly on local devices and partly in the cloud.

cards.title: Industrial Next Accelerates Factory Robot Tasks
cards.body: Industrial Next helps manufacturers automate complex tasks that traditionally required human labor. The platform enables factory robots to switch tasks in minutes instead of weeks.

cards.title: Cerebras CEO Dismisses AI Doomsday Warnings
cards.body: Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman criticized AI leaders spreading doomsday warnings at TechCrunch Disrupt. He argued the industry's focus on risks is drowning out potential benefits.

cards.title: Judge Orders OpenAI to Disclose Hiring Records
cards.body: A federal judge ruled Apple can access OpenAI's interview materials involving former Apple employees. The ruling also grants Apple access to private messages and testimony from key figures.

cards.title: Flox Intelligence Keeps Wildlife Off Infrastructure
cards.body: Flox Intelligence uses AI to keep wildlife away from trains, airports, and roads. The company's edge devices identify animals and deploy species-specific sounds to deter them.

cards.title: Meta Gives Users Algorithm Control
cards.body: Meta launched "Your Algorithm," an AI-powered feature giving users more control over their feed. The feature was first introduced on Instagram.

cards.title: Laplace Intelligence Red-Teams Autonomous Systems
cards.body: Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable University of Michigan spinout is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt.

cards.title: Open Models Have Real Benefits. Do Risks Outweigh Them?
cards.body: Anthropic released a report arguing that powerful open AI models like GLM-5.3 pose major cyberattack risks. The debate centers on whether transparency benefits justify security concerns.

cards.title: AI Labs Buying Data From Dead Startups to Train Models
cards.body: AI companies are acquiring datasets from defunct startups to fuel model training. One founder netted $25,000 selling his crypto startup's codebase and user data.

cards.title: We're Putting Too Much Faith in AI's Ability to Say No
cards.body: Modern AI models are trained to refuse harmful prompts, but this safety mechanism may be overestimated. Researchers question whether chatbots can reliably refuse requests as designed.

cards.title: Researchers Use AI to Design Proteins That Cut Up Proteins
cards.body: Scientists leveraged artificial intelligence to engineer novel proteins with specific enzymatic functions. This breakthrough advances AI applications in biotechnology and protein design.

cards.title: Anthropic Warns Small AI Models Could Self-Replicate Via IoT
cards.body: Anthropic raised concerns that smaller AI models might replicate autonomously through Internet of Things devices. The warning highlights potential risks from distributed, interconnected AI systems.

cards.title: OpenAI, Google AI Models Easily Tricked Into Making Nudes
cards.body: Researchers demonstrated that leading AI models from OpenAI and Google can be manipulated to generate explicit images despite safety guardrails. The findings expose vulnerabilities in current content moderation systems.

cards.title: Disney Offers $20M for Character.AI's Scandal-Plagued Chatbot Tech
cards.body: Disney is acquiring Character.AI's chatbot technology for $20 million amid ongoing scandals. The deal aims to integrate conversational AI into Disney's platform ecosystem.
